title.ja: 図1-1 初手は普通の嬉野流と同じ
title.en: Figure 1-1: First move is the same as ordinary Ureshino style

explain.ja: 初手に▲6八銀と指すのは新嬉野流も通常の嬉野流も同じです。ここから手を進めて、新嬉野流の指し方を見ていきましょう。
explain.en: Shin-Ureshino-ryu also begins with ▲6八銀 on the first move, just like regular Ureshino-ryu. Let's play on from here and see how Shin-Ureshino-ryu is played.

section.ja: 新嬉野流の基本の駒組み
section.en: Basic piece setup of Shin-Ureshino school

title.ja: 図1-2 角を引く手を保留する
title.en: Figure 1-2: Hold off on retreating the bishop

explain.ja: 角を引く手を保留して▲5七銀を急ぐのが新嬉野流の指し方です。ここから相手の出方を見て、嬉野流以外の駒組みにすることも可能です。Yagura 急戦にしたり、対振り飛車急戦に組んだりすることもできます。
explain.en: Shin-Ureshino-ryu postpones retreating the bishop and hurries ▲5七銀. From here Black can watch the opponent's setup and switch to something other than Ureshino-ryu, such as a Yagura rapid attack or a rapid attack against the Ranging Rook.

section.ja: 角引きを保留するのが新嬉野流
section.en: Holding off the bishop retreat is the Shin-Ureshino style

title.ja: 図1-3 ▲8七歩で受けるのが一般的
title.en: Figure 1-3: Defending with ▲8七歩 is common

explain.ja: 相手が飛車先の歩を交換してきたら、▲8八歩ではなく▲8七歩と受けるのも新嬉野流の特徴です。これには、相手の飛車が8六にとどまって5六の歩を狙う順を消すなどの効果があります。ここから先は通常の嬉野流と同じような駒組みになります。ちょっとした違いですが、これが新嬉野流です。
explain.en: Another feature of Shin-Ureshino-ryu is to answer a rook-file pawn exchange with ▲8七歩 instead of ▲8八歩. This has effects such as eliminating lines where White's rook stays on 8六 and targets the pawn on 5六. From here the piece placement is similar to regular Ureshino-ryu. It is a small difference, but that is what defines Shin-Ureshino-ryu.

section.ja: 飛車先交換には▲8七歩で受ける
section.en: Meet a rook pawn exchange with ▲8七歩

line.text: △3二金、▲7八金、△8五歩、▲7九角、△8六歩、▲同歩、△同飛、▲8七歩

title.ja: 図2-1 角引きを急ぐ旧嬉野流の形
title.en: Figure 2-1: Old Ureshino-style formation hurrying the bishop retreat

explain.ja: ここから新嬉野流のメリットとデメリットを見ていきます。図2-1は従来の嬉野流でよく見る駒組みで、相手が△4四角と上がっているのがポイントです。ここから嬉野流側にとって嫌な変化があります。
explain.en: Now let's look at the merits and demerits of Shin-Ureshino-ryu. Diagram 2-1 is a typical setup in the older Ureshino-ryu, and the point is that White has played the bishop up with △4四角. From here there is a line that is unpleasant for the Ureshino-ryu side.

section.ja: 新嬉野流では5筋の歩を取られる変化を消せる
section.en: Shin-Ureshino school can avoid variations where the fifth-file pawn is captured

title.ja: 図2-2 5筋の歩を取られてしまう

explain.ja: 旧嬉野流では5六の歩が浮いてしまう瞬間があるため、その隙に攻められると飛車で5六の歩を狙われてしまいます。さらに数手進めてみましょう。
explain.en: In the older Ureshino-ryu there is a moment when the pawn on 5六 is left unprotected, so if White attacks then, the rook can target the pawn on 5六. Let's play a few more moves.

section.ja: 新嬉野流では5筋の歩を取られる変化を消せる
section.en: Shin-Ureshino school can avoid variations where the fifth-file pawn is captured

title.ja: 図2-3 飛車をぶつけられて嬉野流不満
title.en: Figure 2-3: Rook clash leaves Ureshino style unhappy

explain.ja: さらに相手に△2六飛と回られると、嬉野流側が不満な局面になります。先手は歩を2枚取られる形になり、飛車打ちの隙も残っています。新嬉野流では早めに5六の歩にヒモをつけるので、この変化を避けられます。飛車交換になると嬉野流側が指しにくくなります。
explain.en: If White then swings the rook to △2六飛, the Ureshino-ryu side is unhappy. Black ends up losing two pawns and also leaves a weakness against a rook drop. Shin-Ureshino-ryu supports the 5六 pawn early, so it avoids this line. If rooks are exchanged, Ureshino-ryu becomes hard to play.

section.ja: 新嬉野流では5筋の歩を取られる変化を消せる
section.en: Shin-Ureshino school can avoid variations where the fifth-file pawn is captured

title.en: Figure 2-4: New Ureshino style vs Climbing Silver

explain.ja: 新嬉野流のデメリットは、8七の歩が争点になってしまうことです。図2-4は嬉野流対棒銀の局面で、棒銀に対しては▲6五銀と上がるのが定跡とされています。
explain.en: A demerit of Shin-Ureshino-ryu is that the pawn on 8七 becomes a point of contention. Diagram 2-4 is a position of Ureshino-ryu against Climbing Silver, where the standard reply to Climbing Silver is to advance ▲6五銀. This form is explained in detail in a separate article.

section.ja: 新嬉野流は8七の歩が争点になってしまう
section.en: In Shin-Ureshino school, the pawn on 8七 becomes the point of contention

title.ja: 図2-5 8七の歩が争点になる
title.en: Figure 2-5: The pawn on 8七 becomes the point of contention

explain.ja: △8六歩から棒銀の攻めがあります。新嬉野流では8七に歩を打って受けるため、相手が棒銀などの速攻を見せると攻めが1手早くなってしまいます。嬉野流にはまだ受ける手はありますが、あまり嬉しくない展開です。
explain.en: White can attack with Climbing Silver starting with △8六歩. Because Shin-Ureshino-ryu defends by placing a pawn on 8七, if the opponent shows a fast attack such as Climbing Silver, White's attack comes one move faster. Ureshino-ryu still has defensive moves, but it is an unpleasant development.

section.ja: 新嬉野流は8七の歩が争点になってしまう
section.en: In Shin-Ureshino school, the pawn on 8七 becomes the point of contention
